==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Pinwen:''' Hey there! How about a cup of Chewy-Gummy-Yummy SweeTEA?
:'''Pinwen:''' This tea's a special brew. I ground the tea leaves before steaming and brewing, giving it a smoother, delicate taste. And the boba? Made them with fresh fruits!
:'''Pinwen:''' By extracting them, the fruit's sweetness is kept intact. Take a bite of the boba, and you'll feel the burst of fresh juice in your mouth!
:'''Pinwen:''' I always knew using molecular gastronomy for dessert soups would be a hit! Haha, glad my efforts paid off.
:'''Pinwen:''' Getting the right balance of each ingredient is like doing research. It takes dedication and time. Every little step makes a difference.
:'''Pinwen:''' You know what? Seeing my customers' smiles is as rewarding as getting published in a top-tier journal.
{{Dialogue End}}
